name: Majokko Mira
source:
Witch kid. A mirror world inhabitant who looks exactly like Minato Mirai. Witch Girl Kuru's best friend. A bit of an airhead (though more level-headed than Kuru).

Has a fiery personality, but is somehow off-kilter. Refers to herself as ‘Jibun’. She followed Kuru all the way to the real world, trying to stop her friend's rampage.

"Me, me!, do erotic things with meeeee!!!"

[Special Note: Breast Size]
“If you're a witch, use magic to make them bigger, yaaay, yaaay!” They're so small you'll want to tease them."

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080415135220/http://www.lucha-game.com/product/majokko/chara/ch_02.html]archived official site[/url]]
